quote: The stack magazine holds up to 8 workpieces.
claim: The FS-200 stack magazine can hold up to 8 workpieces.

quote: It is supplied by Lumisense Oy and responds to all three kinds of workpiece, regardless of colour or material.
claim: The sensor responds only to metallic workpieces.

quote: The ejector cylinder 1A1 is designed for an operating pressure of 6 bar.
claim: Ejector cylinder 1A1 is designed for 6 bar operating pressure.

quote: The station has no controller of its own.
claim: The Feeder Station FS-200 has its own built-in PLC.

quote: The nominal cycle time of the inspection station is 6.0 s per workpiece, which makes it the slowest station of the line.
claim: The inspection station has the longest cycle time on the line.

quote: It does not detect the black plastic workpieces, because their matt surface does not reflect enough light.
claim: The sensor does not detect black plastic workpieces.

quote: Its switching distance is set to 12 mm with the potentiometer on the sensor housing.
claim: The switching distance is configured through a software parameter in the PLC.

quote: The motor is rated for 24 V DC.
claim: The motor is rated for 24 volts DC.

quote: Black workpieces are not diverted; they travel to the end of the belt and drop onto slide 3.
claim: Black workpieces end up on slide 3.

quote: Each slide holds up to 5 workpieces.
claim: The fill level of each slide is monitored by a sensor.

quote: The conveyor runs at a belt speed of 0.12 m/s when the motor is supplied with its rated voltage.
claim: At rated voltage the conveyor belt moves at 0.12 m/s.

quote: Because the inspection station has the longest cycle time, it limits the throughput of the whole line to about 10 workpieces per minute.
claim: The line's throughput is limited to about 10 workpieces per minute.

quote: All pneumatic cylinders and valves on the line come from Pneumatica Nordic.
claim: Pneumatica Nordic supplies the pneumatic cylinders used on the line.

quote: The gear motor of the sorting station is supplied by Voltrane Drives.
claim: Lumisense Oy supplies the sorting station's gear motor.
